facts.fact: Mozambique took part, with Angola, Guinea-Bissau and Sao Tome and Principe, in a data governance workshop held in Maputo on 8-10 December 2025, organised by UNESCO with Mozambique's INTIC and Smart Africa; the article is dated 2026-01-29.

systems.system: Carta de Maputo (3rd Forum Lusofono da Governacao da Internet)

note: Workshop was UNESCO-organised, so taking part is member at most; the Lusophone forum charter is not an African body's instrument.
